question: When a good is produced by exploiting natural resources, it falls in the category of:
solution: The correct answer is __**agriculture sector.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • When a good is produced by exploiting natural resources, it falls in the category of **agriculture sector.** • When we produce goods by exploiting natural resources it comes under the** primary sector** as these economic activities are directly tied to the extraction of resources from the earth.
